Params.Value:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')), '') IS NOT NULL
             AND LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')) <> '-1'
            THEN 'EE_AssetID_' + LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID'))
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@TagID')), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'EE_TagID_' + LTRIM(RTRIM('@TagID'))
        ELSE ''
    END AS UniqueKey,
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')), '') IS NOT NULL
             AND LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')) <> '-1'
            THEN 'Asset'
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@TagID')), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'Tag'
        ELSE ''
    END AS [Type],
    CASE
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')), '') IS NOT NULL
             AND LTRIM(RTRIM('@AssetID')) <> '-1'
            THEN ISNULL((SELECT Name FROM _Asset_V WHERE ID = '@AssetID'), 'No Asset Configured')
        WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM('@TagID')), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN ISNULL((SELECT Name FROM EE_Tag_V WHERE ID = '@TagID'), 'No Tag Configured')
        ELSE ''
    END AS SelectedName;
